I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

That comes from #north-random, a channel Dana belongs to. On Oct 13 at 11:55, Ilse posted that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room, and that the power brick under the table shouldn't be unplugged because it resets the Polycom. I passed that tip on too.

I left out the OPS-5546 number Dana mentioned in our private messages. They asked me to keep it to myself, it was only their guess about next year, and it isn't the ticket that's open now.
